title: The Throw-In — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The throw-in is the most underrated moment in football
It happens approximately forty times a game
And approximately forty times a game
Everyone treats it as an inconvenience

[Verse 2 — Español]
Chas dijo — el especialista en el saque de banda es un mito [Chas said — the throw-in specialist is a myth]
Cada equipo tiene un jugador al que se le asignan los saques largos [Every team has one player who gets given the long throws]
Un jugador que practicó en el aparcamiento después del entrenamiento [One player who practised in the car park after training]
Un jugador que puede llegar al área pequeña desde la banda [One player who can reach the six-yard box from the touchline]
Y usa esta habilidad con el entusiasmo de una persona [And uses this ability with the enthusiasm of a person]
Que finalmente ha encontrado su propósito [Who has finally found their purpose]

[Chorus — English]
The throw-in says — here you go
The throw-in says — your turn
Both feet on the ground, both hands on the ball
The throw-in is very specific about the feet

[Bridge — Français]
Le beau jeu s'arrête pour la rentrée en touche [The beautiful game stops for the throw-in]
Prend une respiration [Takes a breath]
Quelqu'un ramasse le ballon [Someone picks up the ball]
Deux pieds sur la ligne [Two feet on the line]
Et le football recommence [And football begins again]
De presque rien [From almost nothing]
Comme il l'a toujours fait [As it always has]

[Verse 3 — English]
Football begins again from almost nothing — as it always has

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The throw-in
El saque de banda [The throw-in]
La rentrée en touche [The throw-in]
That's my boy
